---

### 1. **card-studio.tsx (~346 lines)**

**File path:** `/home/runner/workspace/artifacts/gameforge/src/components/workspace/card-studio.tsx`

**What it renders:**
- A spreadsheet-style interface for managing cards within a deck
- Table with columns: Name, Subtype, Effect/Rules Text, Flavor Text, and Delete button
- Header with card count and subtype breakdown

**Props accepted:**
```typescript
interface CardStudioProps {
  projectId: number;
  deck: Entity;           // Parent deck entity
  cards: Entity[];        // Child card entities
  onRefresh: () => void;  // Callback to refresh card list
}
```

**Sections/Features:**
- **Header** (lines 179-201): Card count display, card subtype distribution, action buttons
- **AI Generate panel** (lines 203-227): Batch generation with prompt input, count selector (3, 5, 8, 12, 20), loading state
- **Add card form** (lines 230-280): Manual card creation with Name, Subtype dropdown, Effect text, Flavor text fields
- **Cards table** (lines 282-344): Editable inline cells for Name, Subtype (dropdown), Effect/Rules Text, Flavor Text; delete button on hover

**Key capabilities:**
- Inline cell editing with Enter/Escape shortcuts
- CSV export functionality
- AI-powered batch card generation with automatic parent assignment
- Subtype tracking and display

**File path:** `/home/runner/workspace/artifacts/gameforge/src/components/workspace/assets-entities.tsx`

5. **Advanced drawer** (lines 396-479) with two tabs:

**Implementation:**

- Rendered as colored badges throughout UI (entities.tsx lines 1527-1529, 2623, assets-entities.tsx lines 2225-2226)

- Status is **NOT** applied to individual cards in Card Studio; it's only on Deck entities and Assets

**Note:** There is **NO "balanced/broken/untested" status** — the system uses draft/needs-art/ready/approved instead.

### 8. **API Hooks for CRUD Operations**

**Entities:**
- `useListEntities(projectId)` - Fetch all entities
- `useCreateEntity()` - Create new entity
  - Signature: `{ projectId, data: { name, type, subtype?, description?, lore?, designNotes?, parentEntityId?, ... } }`
- `useUpdateEntity()` - Update entity
  - Signature: `{ projectId, entityId, data: { /* partial entity */ } }`
- `useDeleteEntity()` - Delete entity
  - Signature: `{ projectId, entityId }`
- `useAiGenerateEntities()` - AI batch generation
- `useAiEnhanceEntity()` - AI enhancement suggestions

**Entity Properties:**
- `useListEntityProperties(projectId, entityId)` - Fetch properties for entity
- `useCreateEntityProperty()` - Create property
  - Signature: `{ projectId, entityId, data: { name, dataType, defaultValue?, textValue? } }`
- `useUpdateEntityProperty()` - Update property
  - Signature: `{ projectId, entityId, propertyId, data: { /* partial property */ } }`
- `useDeleteEntityProperty()` - Delete property
  - Signature: `{ projectId, entityId, propertyId }`

**Assets:**
- `useListAssets(projectId)` - Fetch all assets
- `useCreateAsset()` - Create asset
  - Signature: `{ projectId, data: { name, kind, description?, flavorText?, entityId?, status, quantity } }`
- `useUpdateAsset()` - Update asset
  - Signature: `{ projectId, assetId, data: { /* partial asset */ } }`
- `useDeleteAsset()` - Delete asset
- `useAiEnhanceAsset()` - AI enhancement suggestions
- `useGenerateAssetImageVariations()` - Generate image variations
- `useSelectAssetVariation()` - Select preferred variation

**Query cache invalidation:**
- `getListEntitiesQueryKey(projectId)` - Cache key for entity list
- `getListEntityPropertiesQueryKey(projectId, entityId)` - Cache key for property list
- `getListAssetsQueryKey(projectId)` - Cache key for asset list

### Key Data Structures

**Entity model:**
```typescript
{
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  name: string;
  type: ComponentType; // Physical or World type
  subtype?: string;
  description?: string;
  lore?: string;
  designNotes?: string;
  stats?: string;        // Free-form stat string (e.g., "ATK 3 / DEF 1")
  relatedTo?: string;    // Relationship links to other entities
  status?: string;       // draft | needs-art | ready | approved
  parentEntityId?: number; // For cards belonging to a deck
  color?: string;        // Custom card color
}
```

**Asset model:**
```typescript
{
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  name: string;
  kind: string;          // card | token | tile | board | dice | rulebook | other
  description?: string;
  flavorText?: string;
  entityId?: number;     // Link to related Entity
  imageDataUrl?: string; // Generated or uploaded image
  status: string;        // draft | needs-art | ready | approved
  quantity: number;
  displayOrder?: number;
  groupDisplayOrder?: number;
}
```
